description:
pattern     stage-callout / cta
surface     dark
kit         signature centered above heading
form        Columns 1–12 arrange an expansive cinematic call to action with a commanding editorial headline, contemplative supporting copy, and an interactive primary action button with magnetic cursor attraction. On mobile, elements stack with centered alignment.
copy
  eyebrow      THE NEXT CHAPTER
  heading      The Story Doesn't End Here.
  supporting   The degree is complete, but the engineering journey is just accelerating. I am actively seeking high-impact software engineering roles, collaborative ventures, and transformative challenges worldwide.
  cta-button   Chapter Next →
motion      Text and button reveal at 100ms with translate-Y 20px and subtle background glow intensification.
plan check  heading "The Story Doesn't End Here." placed; supporting line placed; "Chapter Next →" button placed.
layout_description: Single centered cinematic column with large display heading, body narrative, and prominent interactive CTA button.
